scientific_integrity: Complete exact cyclotomic and integral-reduction computation supplied; uses the classical twenty-eight-bitangent theorem for smooth plane quartics in characteristic other than two. Historical priority awaits independent review.
scientific_limitations: Literal Klein plane model only; excludes characteristics two and seven and nontrivial twists; algorithmic certificate uses SymPy exact arithmetic. The 2010-08-24 date is the earliest precisely day-verified public source date used in the record, not the original publication date of the 1998 Elkies antecedent.
title: Cyclotomic Frobenius classification of the Klein quartic bitangents in odd characteristic
